text:
By Post author ,
8 hours ago Arthur Stone Dewing was reborn as an economics instructor in 1911 according to his own account. He went on to become a finance professor at the Harvard Business School. A busy, full and complete life, successful by any metric, and yet the sort of academic that requires a professional historian of economics to go deep into the weeds just to seek an interesting trace of a lasting contribution. His Boston Globe obit credits him with the introduction of the case method into the Harvard Business School program. Worth checking if in fact a true claim. Read full article
